test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**must**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Must** is used for **obligations and necessities.**

 
 
• Example -*** I must have a proper job before moving to Canada***.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, We must start taking care of ourselves bec
